I settled in Tehran in 2018, before that I was a student and commuted. I remember the thing that always bothered me was the bolder face of poverty here compared to Isfahan. Metro peddlers, working children, etc. 

Now I see how normal it has become for me to see these things, I don't know if I'm fat or careless, but I hate myself!
